title: Challenge 2.2: Complete Diagnostic Keyword Library
description: Build a complete diagnostic keyword library with arguments, return values, documentation, and hierarchical structure.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, it's time to prove your mastery. Build a COMPLETE diagnostic keyword library - arguments, returns, documentation, hierarchy - all of it!"
story.context: This challenge combines everything: documented keywords with arguments and return values, keywords calling keywords, and clean test abstraction.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "OUTSTANDING! You've built a professional-grade keyword library. This is how real test automation is structured!"

instructions: Create the *** Test Cases *** section with ONE test: 'Complete Diagnostic Suite'
Test should call ONE keyword: Run Full Diagnostics
Create the *** Keywords *** section with these keywords:
[Documentation]: Executes complete diagnostic suite on all ship systems
[Documentation]: Checks a specific system and returns OK or FAIL
hints: Test → Run Full Diagnostics → Check All Systems + Generate Report
Check All Systems calls Check Individual System 3 times
Build hierarchy: Test → High-level → Mid-level → Low-level
solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Complete Diagnostic Suite
    Run Full Diagnostics

*** Keywords ***
Run Full Diagnostics
    [Documentation]    Executes complete diagnostic suite on all ship systems
    Check All Systems
    Generate Diagnostic Report

Check All Systems
    [Documentation]    Checks all three critical systems
    ${power_ok}=    Check Individual System    power
    ${nav_ok}=    Check Individual System    navigation
    ${life_ok}=    Check Individual System    life-support
    Log    Power: ${power_ok}
    Log    Navigation: ${nav_ok}
    Log    Life Support: ${life_ok}

Check Individual System
    [Documentation]    Checks a specific system and returns OK or FAIL
    [Arguments]    ${system_name}
    Log    Checking ${system_name} system
    RETURN    OK

Generate Diagnostic Report
    [Documentation]    Creates final diagnostic summary
    Log    === Diagnostic Report ===
    Log    All systems checked successfully

theory.title: Challenge 2.2: Complete Keyword Library
theory.content:
🏆 Master Keyword Engineer

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, this is it. The complete package. Every keyword technique we've learned, combined into one elegant diagnostic library."

"One test, calling one keyword, which orchestrates everything underneath. This is professional test automation."

🎯 Challenge Requirements

You Must Demonstrate:

  • ✅ [Documentation] - Document all four keywords
  • ✅ [Arguments] - Check Individual System accepts ${system_name}
  • ✅ RETURN - Check Individual System returns status
  • ✅ Variable capture - ${var}= to capture return values
  • ✅ Hierarchy - Test → High → Mid → Low keyword structure
  • ✅ Reusability - Check Individual System called 3 times

📝 Expected Structure

Test: Complete Diagnostic Suite
  ↓
Run Full Diagnostics [documented]
  ↓
  ├→ Check All Systems [documented]
  │   ↓
  │   ├→ Check Individual System (power) [documented, with args, returns]
  │   ├→ Check Individual System (navigation) [reused]
  │   └→ Check Individual System (life-support) [reused]
  │
  └→ Generate Diagnostic Report [documented]

🏅 Success Criteria

  • 🔹 4 keywords total: All properly documented
  • 🔹 Hierarchical calls: Test → High → Mid → Low
  • 🔹 Arguments used: ${system_name} parameter
  • 🔹 Returns captured: ${power_ok}, ${nav_ok}, ${life_ok}
  • 🔹 All tests pass: Complete execution succeeds

🎯 Your Challenge

Build the complete diagnostic library! This is your graduation from keyword basics to professional test automation architecture.
